gaps.detail: the artifact IS on origin/main (us-eod/2026-11-23.csv, 4,882 rows, 32 columns, commit 3beadc6) but it landed 130.1 min after the 16:00 ET fire - over cron #20's own 110-min allowance in latency.per_routine_allowed_minutes - so the state is delivered_late, not missing. The cause is a SLOW RUN, not a platform failure: session 466590269395056 ended healthily (status 0, empty status_message, 258,606 tokens, finish_reason 'stop'), and the work it actually did was large - it adjudicated 279 disputed prior closes against the exchange record, fixed the anchor rule in the repo (commits 131d13b, 53372d7) with a fault-injection test, and re-ran derive -> report -> gate (34/34) before pushing. The run record's ~10 s duration measures the DISPATCH, not the work. It is over the allowance on 1 of its last 3 due days (11-20: 80 min, 11-19: 81 min), so it is NOT chronically late; its 11-18 reading (561 min) falls outside that window. Recommended action: either optimise the settle loop or raise cron #20's per-routine allowance to ~135 min - the auditor does not widen it itself.
